description: Load styles from another InDesign document or template: paragraph, character, all text, object, table, cell, table and cell, TOC or stroke styles, choosing how name conflicts resolve (Load Styles in the style panel menus)

conflicts.description: When a style with the same name exists: rename the incoming one, overwrite the existing one, or skip it

filePath.description: The InDesign document (.indd) or template (.indt) to load from

types.description: Which styles to load: text loads paragraph and character styles, table_and_cell loads both table and cell styles

name: load_styles
title: Load Styles
